fusions.name: Unbending Shoulder
fusions.desc: A shoulder charge that deals 13 damage, leaves the target 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds and knocks it 3.5 tiles back. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Driven Nail
fusions.desc: Drives a cold spike into a target up to 7 tiles away, dealing 26 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 20% health.

fusions.name: Quicksilver Skin
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. You move 30% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Cold-Forged Heels
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
